backing.backing_score_conflict: ✅ RESOLVED 2026-09-11 FROM RE'S OWN DOCUMENTATION, NOT BY ARBITRATING BETWEEN OUR TWO ROWS. docs.re.xyz/capital-stack-and-loss-waterfall/loss-waterfall-order states the waterfall bottom-to-top as: reinsurance premiums -> Re capital (junior/first-loss) -> reUSDe (MEZZANINE) -> reUSD (SENIOR), with stated impairment probabilities of 3.9% / 0.9% / 0.03%. Verbatim: 'should an extreme event bring about losses to reUSDe, it'll absorb further losses before reUSD is impacted.' ⚠️⚠️ THE CUT CORRECTLY DOES NOT PROPAGATE, AND THE REASON IS THAT THE TWO ATTACHMENT POINTS COUNT DIFFERENT THINGS: reUSD's backing cut (5.5 -> 5.0 on 2026-09-06) priced the SENIOR'S attachment point — the cushion beneath reUSD, which is Re capital PLUS reUSDe ITSELF. reUSDe's own cushion is Re capital ALONE. A thinning senior attachment point is therefore not the same measurement as a thinning mezzanine cushion, and applying one to the other would import a figure whose denominator includes the very tranche being scored. ✅ SO 5.5 STANDS AND WAS NOT MOVED. ⚠️ WHAT IS DEFECTIVE IS THE SENTENCE 'SAME reinsurance book as reUSD, THEREFORE the same score': the BOOK is genuinely the same and the CONCLUSION does not follow from it, because these rows price different questions — reUSD's backing includes subordination adequacy, reUSDe's explicitly excludes it (carried on Volatility 3.5 and Redemption 2.0). The clause was true while both read 5.5 and became misleading the moment one moved for a tranche-specific reason. ⚠️ A COINCIDING NUMBER HELD AN UNSOUND INFERENCE UPRIGHT FOR THREE DAYS — remove the 'therefore', keep the shared-book fact.
backing.backing_score_tranche: ⚠️ reUSDe IS THE MEZZANINE (SECOND-LOSS) TRANCHE, reUSD IS THE SENIOR — confirmed against Re's docs 2026-09-11. Stated impairment probability 0.9% against the senior's 0.03%: THIRTY TIMES more likely to be impaired, on the same book. Any comparison of these two assets that does not carry the tranche is comparing two different instruments by their shared collateral.

The score rests on the primary channel, not a venue.

The half-point gap against reUSD is that extra leg, priced once.

An axis-4 sweep pairs reusde-re 4.0 against usde 6.0 because sUSDe appears in `underlying_assets` — ⚠️ BUT THAT IS COLLATERAL, NOT WRAPPING. reUSDe does not wrap sUSDe; it is Re's MEZZANINE tranche which holds sUSDe as collateral.
